title: Steering a camera with the keyboard

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Imagine aiming a precision camera mount just by pressing keys. That's what this small controller does.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A Directed Perception PTU-46, a pan-tilt unit that points a camera left, right, up and down.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And how do the keys become motion?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Antoine wrote a desktop interface in Python with Qt. It listens for keyboard input and turns it into commands sent over a serial connection with pyserial.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Keys, interface, serial commands, motors. The repository is archived now, and the written page has the details.
